entries.title: Background work on your Mac
entries.body: Session summaries, memory, workspace insights and file maps, recall, the Pulse briefing and the AI buttons run on a model on this Mac and never spend. When it can't answer, the work waits or uses heuristics; nothing falls back to a paid model unless you allow it. An install from before 2.0 is asked once, and Settings ▸ Local engine can go local or undo it later.

entries.title: Your Chief of Staff on Opus 5.5 or gpt-6-sol
entries.body: Its duties run on Claude Code · claude-opus-5-5 or Codex · gpt-6-sol, and with both hosts a duty that can't start on one moves to the other. The hourly check triages on this Mac first, so a quiet hour costs nothing. With no host yet, Pulse says how to add one.

entries.title: Your Claude Code and Codex history
entries.body: `aos import` brings your CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md rules, Claude Code's memories, both hosts' MCP servers and your past sessions into the vault, on the local model. Imported memories wait in Brain ▸ Review, one batch per host, until you keep them.

entries.title: A guided tour, Getting started and Help
entries.body: Help (the ? at the rail's foot, ⌘P or the app's Help menu) has the welcome tour, a tour of the tab you are on and this list. Each tab offers its own tour on your first visit, and Getting started ticks first steps as you do them.
